'''Feero''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a Republic scout and a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to help him find probe droids that are trapped inside the contaminated ruins of Traken-4, an Imperial outpost.
